name: Mizuno Takahiro
source: Once a prominent talent as a knight in the junior championships, an injury and defeat caused him to leave the scene. Though not fully able to abandon the path of jousting and his love for horses, he studies at Wynn Ford Academy as a begleiter. His former experience and talent as a knight makes him a desirable begleiter to many aspiring knights.
